name: LIKE_PCT_WILDCARD
description: LIKE '%' matches zero or more characters
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT 'abc' LIKE 'a%', 'abc' LIKE '%c', 'abc' LIKE '%b%', 'abc' LIKE '%';

name: LIKE_UNDERSCORE_WILDCARD
description: LIKE '_' matches exactly one character
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT 'abc' LIKE 'a_c', 'abc' LIKE '___', 'abc' LIKE '__', 'a' LIKE '_';

name: LIKE_ESCAPE_UNDERSCORE
description: LIKE ESCAPE '!' treats !_ as a literal underscore
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT 'a_c' LIKE 'a!_c' ESCAPE '!', 'abc' LIKE 'a!_c' ESCAPE '!', 'a_c' LIKE 'a_c';

name: LIKE_ESCAPE_PERCENT
description: LIKE ESCAPE '!' treats !% as a literal percent
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT 'a%c' LIKE 'a!%c' ESCAPE '!', 'abc' LIKE 'a!%c' ESCAPE '!', 'a%c' LIKE 'a%c';

name: LIKE_CASE_INSENSITIVE_ASCII_DEFAULT
description: Default LIKE is case-insensitive for ASCII characters
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT 'abc' LIKE 'A%', 'ABC' LIKE 'a%', 'AbC' LIKE 'a_c';

name: LIKE_CASE_SENSITIVE_PRAGMA_ON
description: PRAGMA case_sensitive_like=ON makes LIKE byte-exact for ASCII

name: NOT_LIKE_BASIC
description: NOT LIKE inverts a LIKE result and preserves NULL
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT 'abc' NOT LIKE 'a%', 'abc' NOT LIKE 'z%', NULL NOT LIKE 'a%';

name: GLOB_STAR_WILDCARD
description: GLOB '*' matches zero or more characters (case-sensitive)
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT 'abc' GLOB 'a*', 'abc' GLOB '*c', 'ABC' GLOB 'a*', 'abc' GLOB '*';

name: GLOB_QUESTION_WILDCARD
description: GLOB '?' matches exactly one character
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT 'abc' GLOB 'a?c', 'abc' GLOB '???', 'ab' GLOB '???';

name: GLOB_CHAR_CLASS
description: GLOB '[abc]' matches one of the listed characters
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT 'abc' GLOB '[abc]bc', 'dbc' GLOB '[abc]bc';

name: GLOB_CHAR_RANGE
description: GLOB '[a-z]' matches a character in the given range
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT 'abc' GLOB '[a-z][a-z][a-z]', 'aBc' GLOB '[a-z][a-z][a-z]';

name: GLOB_NEGATED_CHAR_CLASS
description: GLOB '[^abc]' matches anything except the listed characters
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT 'dbc' GLOB '[^abc]bc', 'abc' GLOB '[^abc]bc';

name: NOT_GLOB_BASIC
description: NOT GLOB inverts GLOB and preserves NULL semantics
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT 'abc' NOT GLOB 'a*', 'abc' NOT GLOB 'z*', NULL NOT GLOB 'a*';

name: REGEXP_POSITIVE
description: REGEXP operator (sqlite3 CLI loads default regex)
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT 'abc' REGEXP 'a.*', 'abc' REGEXP '^[a-z]+$', 'ABC' REGEXP '^[a-z]+$';

name: LIKE_ON_INTEGER_COERCES
description: LIKE on integer coerces operand to text
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT 12345 LIKE '12%', 12345 LIKE '_2345', typeof(12345);

name: LIKE_WITH_NULL_PATTERN_VALUE
description: LIKE with NULL on either side returns NULL
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT NULL LIKE 'a%', 'abc' LIKE NULL, NULL LIKE NULL;

name: GLOB_WITH_NULL
description: GLOB with NULL on either side returns NULL
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT NULL GLOB 'a*', 'abc' GLOB NULL, NULL GLOB NULL;

name: NOT_LIKE_PRESERVES_NULL
description: NOT LIKE returns NULL when either operand is NULL
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT NULL NOT LIKE 'a%', 'abc' NOT LIKE NULL;

name: LIKE_INSIDE_CHECK_CONSTRAINT
description: LIKE used inside a CHECK constraint accepts matching values

name: LIKE_ON_INDEXED_COLUMN
description: LIKE on indexed column returns matching rows (functional verification)

name: LIKE_MULTIBYTE_NOT_FOLDED
description: Built-in LIKE case folding is ASCII-only; non-ASCII does not match across case
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT 'café' LIKE 'café', 'CAFÉ' LIKE 'café', 'cafe' LIKE 'CAFE', 'CAFE' LIKE 'cafe';

name: GLOB_CASE_SENSITIVE_ALWAYS
description: GLOB is always case-sensitive regardless of PRAGMA case_sensitive_like
